calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
  AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.product_key) as total_product_keys,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN dpo.sku IS NOT NULL THEN f.product_key END) as matched_to_old_dim
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
LEFT JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12

SELECT 
  f.sale_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipts,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_product_old dpo ON dp.sku = dpo.sku
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 12
  AND dpo.category = 'Garden'
GROUP BY f.sale_date
ORDER BY f.sale_date DESC
LIMIT 10
